prediction_registered_before_measuring: base composition differs between methylated and unmethylated instances INSIDE the fixed 565-instance H set at >=1 of 20 flanking offsets (-10..-1, +7..+16); 80 Fisher tests per timepoint, BH 5%, must replicate at T1, T2 and T3
measurement: Under the REGISTERED rule (80 Fisher tests per timepoint, BH 5 %, replication required at T1, T2 and T3) exactly two offsets survive: -5 (C enriched, q = 2.6e-06 / 1.7e-03 / 2.1e-02) and -3 (G enriched q = 2.8e-12 / 3.8e-15 / 4.8e-16; A depleted q = 1.3e-07 / 5.1e-10 / 4.8e-09). Joint logistic model with local GC (101 bp) and log depth: -3=G log-odds +2.147/+2.676/+2.831 vs -3=A (OR 8.6/14.5/17.0); -5=C +0.694/+0.909/+0.957. Out-of-sample AUC 0.776 [0.748-0.823] vs 0.698 [0.664-0.724] for local GC alone (20 random 50/50 site splits, T1)
note: SUPPORTED on two offsets (-5, -3), not four. CORRECTED 2026-10-16 after audit: the first version of this row listed -6(A) and -4(C) as surviving, which is true only of the secondary permissive scan. prediction_registered_before_measuring: if the -3 effect is a nanopore k-mer artefact it must also appear in the non-target GAAGCCCG instances and in the genome-wide adenine background propagated additively
measurement: non-target GAAGCCCG set, -3=G vs -3=A: occupancy 10.1% vs 9.0%, OR 1.13 (T1). Genome-wide non-motif adenines: false-positive mean level 5.20% (-3=G) vs 3.45% (-3=A); propagated additively as f+(1-f)*eps this accounts for 1.16 pp of the observed 14.23 pp level difference = 8.1%. 4mC at C4 on the same H instances orders A 59.8 < G 76.8 < C 80.7 < T 87.2 %, i.e. G is NOT maximal
note: the false-NEGATIVE (sensitivity) channel cannot be bounded without a fully methylated control - this remains the residual caveat
